description: Add the ability for users to rename documents directly from the documents table interface. This should include a new 'Rename' option in the document action dropdown menu and a dialog component to handle the title update process. The feature must ensure proper validation and immediate UI updates after successful renaming.
functional_requirements: Add a 'Rename' option to the document action dropdown menu in the documents table
Create a dialog component that allows users to input a new document title with proper validation (preventing empty/invalid titles)
Implement backend logic to handle document title updates and ensure proper data persistence
Update the UI immediately to reflect the new document name after successful renaming
Maintain consistency with existing document management patterns and styling
Ensure the rename functionality works seamlessly with existing document-related features
